title: Increased Errors for Durable Objects in Seattle
summary: The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.

timeline.body: Cloudflare is aware of, and investigating an issue with Durable Objects which potentially impacts multiple customers in Seattle. Durable Objects are experiencing an elevated level of overload errors in the aforementioned region. We are currently investigating this issue.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.
timeline.label: identified
